//: Workspace root for one frozen pnpm lock and the four web/server/e2e/broker workspaces. Each workspace declares its own module type; deliberately keep the root without a type field.
name: queuepilot

scripts.build: pnpm --filter queuepilot-web run build && pnpm --filter queuepilot-server run build
scripts.install-playwright-browser: pnpm --filter queuepilot-e2e run playwright install chromium --with-deps
scripts.test: pnpm --filter queuepilot-web run test && pnpm --filter queuepilot-server run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter queuepilot-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter queuepilot-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter queuepilot-e2e run typecheck
